correctness.rationale: The normalized pgf has one numerator zero and a single negative-binomial factor; expanding its logarithm gives (alpha q^k-r^k)/k>0 and absolute summability. Under thinning, q_t=t/(theta+t) and r_t=t/(theta+1+t). Differentiating the logarithmic coefficients in t shows that the ratio of the subtracted to the positive derivative, before the factor alpha, is ((theta+1)/theta)((theta+t)/(theta+1+t))^2(r_t/q_t)^(k-1). It is strictly less than A(theta) for t<1, and tends to A(theta) for k=1 as t tends to one. Integration proves the strictly positive innovation intensities including equality; if alpha<A(theta), the first logarithmic coefficient, and hence H_t'(0), is negative for t close enough to one. The pgf quotient determines the innovation law uniquely. A(theta)-1 has numerator 1-theta-theta², confirming the admissible-shape transition. At the rational WNBL witness q=49/51, r=49/100, q_(1/2)=49/53 and r_(1/2)=49/151; the exact first log coefficient is -249361/2400900. Bakouch's original mgf/pgf and stated parameter range admit this witness, and Definition 5.3 uses the same thinning convention. Read VERIFICATION.md and check.py; did not execute the frozen script.
